title: Drumboiii HDRI Setup + Lattice for Squishy Movements
promoted_rules: Separate HDRI lighting and reflections from the camera-visible background with Is Camera Ray.
Build procedural clouds from Noise plus ColorRamp and depth from Gradient plus ColorRamp.
Tune procedural sky scale against the final camera focal length.
Build squishy motion from scale overshoot plus a secondary animated Lattice.
Start the Lattice action slightly before or overlapping the primary pop.
Reserve high subdivision and final smoothing for the end of the workflow.
transfer_constraints: Physical and identity gates remain higher authority than style.
Tutorial strengths and frame numbers are examples, not constants.
Multi-mesh assets require one shared Lattice modifier assignment per deformable mesh.
Global motion remains on a separate root control.
